|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[A Close Race (V)]] (version 4 of 4). It is the current text. * '''Original''' ([[A Close Race (V)]]): the card image at official release (20 July 2024)<ref name="ht-335d47f">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/acloserace.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Light/large/acloserace.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36 335d47f] “Set 23 new images”, 20 July 2024.</ref> prints: “Plays on table. If an Undercover spy was just lost, it is placed out of play.”<ref name="cj-753083f">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/753083f swccg-card-json commit 753083f] “Set 23” (21 July 2024) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[A Close Race (V) (Errata)]]): the errata card image (24 July 2024, for the PC's July 2024 Undercover-spy shield errata)<ref name="ht-013e17b">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/013e17be50f1206449af38f66ba66be77ae8f27c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/acloserace.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Light/large/acloserace.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/013e17be50f1206449af38f66ba66be77ae8f27c 013e17b] “UC Spy Shield Erratas”, 24 July 2024, for the PC's July 2024 Undercover-spy shield errata.</ref> prints: “Plays on table. You lose no Force to Boonta Eve Podrace. While you occupy three battlegrounds, Watto’s Box is suspended. Nevar Yalnal may not target opponent’s Undercover spies. If an Undercover spy is about to be lost, place it out of play instead.”<ref name="cj-1a9e32e">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/1a9e32e swccg-card-json commit 1a9e32e] “Errata and a couple fixes” (27 July 2024) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' “If an Undercover spy was just lost, it is placed out of play.” became “If an Undercover spy is about to be lost, place it out of play instead.” The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[A Close Race (V) (Errata 2)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit<ref name="sheetD-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF, 3 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 2 August 2024: “Plays on table. You lose no Force to Boonta Eve Podrace. While you occupy three battlegrounds, Watto's Box is suspended. Nevar Yalnal may not target opponent's Undercover spies. If an Undercover spy is about to be lost (for any reason), place it out of play instead.” '''What changed:''' Changed words: the slip is the first publication of the wording of the card image [[A Close Race (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3), which the PC published after the sheet. Game text: “lost,” became “lost (for any reason),”. The sheet PDF was created at 05:50 UTC on 2 August 2024, before the card image [[A Close Race (V) (Errata 3)]] was uploaded (06:12 UTC, 2 August 2024). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•A Close Race”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[A Close Race (V) (Errata 3)]] (published 2 August 2024) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[A Close Race]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints “E2”.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the errata card image (2 August 2024, for the PC's August 2024 errata)<ref name="ht-0151016">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/01510164a92d5f5f539a11fe4f25ea59efde4149/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Light/large/acloserace.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual23-Light/large/acloserace.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/01510164a92d5f5f539a11fe4f25ea59efde4149 0151016] “Minor fixes”, 2 August 2024, for the PC's August 2024 errata.</ref> prints: “Plays on table. If an Undercover spy is about to be lost (for any reason), place it out of play instead.”<ref name="cj-f5898ba">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/f5898ba swccg-card-json commit f5898ba] “Minor errata updates” (13 August 2024) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' “(for any reason)” was added after “is about to be lost”.
